headline: Indian equity benchmarks trade lower amid inflation fears, with major financials and auto stocks under pressure

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Inflation fears weighed on investor sentiment across Indian benchmark indices.
Major weighted stocks including HDFC Bank, Titan, and Shriram Finance led the market drop.
Chief Economic Adviser Nageswaran warned that supply shocks could weaken monetary policy effectiveness.
Persistent market volatility saw Nifty slipping below 25,150 during intraday trade.
whatHappening: Dish TV reported a Q2 net loss of ₹295 crore, which exceeded its quarterly revenue of ₹292 crore.
FACT reported an 86% jump in Q2 net profit, while Gillette India posted a 10% profit increase.
SpiceJet announced a board meeting on November 18 to discuss fundraising proposals.
CCPA imposed a ₹10 lakh fine on Ola over its pre-ride tipping feature and ordered its discontinuation.
summary: Indian stock markets traded lower today as Sensex and Nifty succumbed to inflation concerns and weakness in key sector heavyweights. Shriram Finance, HDFC Bank, Titan, and Manappuram Finance registered notable declines. On the earnings front, FACT and Gillette reported solid Q2 growth, while Dish TV posted a heavy net loss.
